LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Facts_fish: They will fish the water by their camp, away from the colony's own fishing spots, and dry the catch at their fire.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Facts_strip: They will take the ruins near their camp apart, piece by piece, and stack what comes out of them at their camp.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Facts_reap: They are looking for harvest work: taken on, they reap the colony's ripe crops by day.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Facts_hull: Their wrecked craft lies by their camp, and they will work at it by day; when they go, they leave it behind.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Facts_watch: One or two of them will keep watch at the monolith through the night, by turns.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_HullLeft: The {NAME} left their wrecked hull {PLACE}. It is nobody's now, and the colony can take it apart.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_declined: The {NAME} from {FACTION} found no work at the colony, packed up their camp {PLACE} and moved on to the next farm.
LanguageData.CC_CampReap_NoSupper: The {NAME} worked the colony's fields all day, and there were no meals in the stores for their supper. They went to bed hungry, and they won't forget it.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_fish: {X_nameDef} left {COUNT} {THING} from their catch at the edge of the camp {PLACE}, for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_scrap: {X_nameDef} left {COUNT} {THING} from their haul at the edge of the camp {PLACE}, for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_CampErrand_Arrived_showfish: {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} is standing by the water where the fish are thickest, showing the colony where to fish.
LanguageData.CC_CampErrand_Week_showfish: {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} shows the colony where the fish are thickest
LanguageData.CC_CampErrand_No_richwater: There's no water with fish in it near the colony that they could reach.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_CampTo_richwater: the water with the most fish
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoFarWater: There's no water away from the colony for them to fish.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoRuin: There are no ruins left outside the home area for them to take down.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Hired: They're already at work in the colony's fields.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoBeast: The colony has no beast they'd buy: grown, sound, out of any pen and bonded to nobody.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoChildren: The colony has no children old enough to help.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoStudy: The colony has no study of the unnatural under way for their notes to add to.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoStorm: Only when the weather is foul.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoBeds: The colony has no free bed under a roof for them.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_CatchGoing: One of them is already bringing their catch over.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoCatch: They haven't caught enough to sell yet.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoPorter: None of them is free to carry it.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_HaulGoing: Their share of the haul is already on its way.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoHaul: They haven't stripped enough yet to split.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_CatchSold: {X_nameDef} set down {COUNT} {THING} from the fishers' catch by the colony's gate, and {SILVER} silver for it is going over to their camp.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_CatchSoldShort: {X_nameDef} set down {COUNT} {THING} by the colony's gate. It came to {PRICE} silver, but the colony had only {SILVER} left to send over, and the {NAME} took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_CatchSoldUnpaid: {X_nameDef} set down {COUNT} {THING} by the colony's gate, but the colony had no silver left for the {PRICE} it came to, and the {NAME} took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_HaulBrought: {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} set down {COUNT} {THING} from their haul by the colony's gate: the colony's half.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_RuinsLeave: The {NAME} won't work ruins somebody else claims. They're packing up their camp {PLACE}.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_RuinsFee: The {NAME} will pay the colony {COUNT} silver every five days to finish the ruins, the first tomorrow, set out at the edge of their camp.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_BeastSold: {THING} is the {NAME}'s now and goes to their fence; one of them is bringing {COUNT} silver up to the colony's gate. {A_nameDef} watched it go.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_BeastSoldNoKeeper: {THING} is the {NAME}'s now and goes to their fence; one of them is bringing {COUNT} silver up to the colony's gate.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_CatchSale: One of the {0} carries their catch to the colony's gate, and the colony pays for it there
LanguageData.CC_Impact_HaulShare: Two of the {0} carry half of their biggest piles of salvage to the colony's gate
LanguageData.CC_Impact_FarWater: The {0} fish only the water away from the colony and its fishing spots, and catch less
LanguageData.CC_Impact_NearWater: The {0} may fish the water near the colony again
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ClearNear: The {0} take down the ruin nearest the colony first; what they strip stays theirs
LanguageData.CC_Impact_RuinsFee: The {0} pay {1} silver every five days to finish
LanguageData.CC_Impact_Reap: The {0} reap the colony's ripe crops by day and leave them for its haulers
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ReapSheaf: One in ten of what they reap goes in their packs
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ReapMeals: {0} cooked meals carried to their camp each evening they worked
LanguageData.CC_Impact_MonolithNotes: The colony's study of the unnatural gains {0} knowledge
LanguageData.CC_Impact_Shelter: The {0} sleep in the colony's free beds tonight and give them back in the morning
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ChildrenFeed: {0} help the keepers of the {1} feed their beasts for an hour or two (Animals practice)
